facts.value: Checks fast-fall eligibility before selecting fast-fall velocity or ordinary gravity. Successful ftCommon_CheckFallFast activation sets fall_fast, sets x671_timer_lstick_tilt_y to 0xFE and calls ft_PlaySFX. Horizontal requests are stick.x times drift_max and target_max when ABS(input.lstick[0].x) >= threshold, otherwise both are zero; aerial_friction is always forwarded to ftCommon_8007D140. Equality qualifies. The local body performs no action-state transition or finite-value validation.
facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline no-timer assertion using the actual eligibility callee and records the canonical input field and inclusive gate.

evidence.why: Ordered selection, inclusive gate and arguments.

facts.value: The TU selects movement calculations without local action-state transitions. ft_80084E1C checks fast fall before choosing vertical processing and uses an inclusive absolute-stick gate for horizontal requests; its eligibility callee can update the tilt timer and call SFX. ft_80084F3C and ft_80084FA8 multiply friction only strictly above walk_max_vel, without proving increased braking. x594_b0 selects translation-derived acceleration in ft_80085030 or direct gr_vel replacement in ft_800850E0, otherwise supplied friction is used. Both finish through common ground movement; ft_800850E0's enabled branch leaves existing ground acceleration available. ft_800851D0 selects scaled versus unscaled Y by x197C presence. Other component-copy and rotation helpers replace selected components unconditionally.
facts.rationale: Repairs overstrong friction wording and covers all owned mode guards, optional Y scaling and delegated fast-fall side effects.
